local_execution_environment.portability: This machine's QCSim build and QASM corpus are outside the publish candidate; these pins validate the current host only, not clean-clone reproduction.

qcsim_precision_sources.configuration: explicit SimulatorType.QCSim and SimulationType.Statevector; keep CPU-irrelevant use_double_precision at false/default and validate result simulator/method IDs.

context.seed_derivation: uint32 from first four SHA256 digest bytes, big-endian, of root_seed|registered simulator stream|qasm_sha256|context_id|repetition. For synthetic cells qasm_sha256 is the exact synthetic-QASM hash. repetition is 1..15 for the three sessions x five calls.
context.precision_validation: pin the native binding and QCSimState source/build hashes; require explicit SimulatorType.QCSim and SimulationType.Statevector in the resolved configuration and result metadata. use_double_precision is GPU-MPS/TN-only and remains false for CPU QCSim.
context.qcsim_openmp_note: Pinned QCSim uses explicit OpenMP num_threads(processor_count) based on hardware_concurrency; OMP_NUM_THREADS alone is not a hard cap. Set OMP_THREAD_LIMIT=1 before worker import for the primary arm; the unset arm removes both OMP variables.
context.cpu_affinity: capture allowed CPU set once and retain across arms/calibration/panel; do not select it using runtime
context.identity: actual worker binary/library hashes, versions, resolved simulator config, CPU, affinity and thread-pool fingerprint

normalization.qasm2_custom_instruction_policy: strict QASM2 parse with Qiskit 2.5.2 LEGACY_CUSTOM_INSTRUCTIONS to recognize gates already used in the exact source QASM; do not rewrite source text or silently drop operations
normalization.measurement_mapping: nonempty terminal injective qubit-to-classical-bit map; allow partial measured-qubit subsets and unused classical bits; preserve ordered map and both register widths exactly; barriers after first measure allowed, any other operation unavailable
normalization.equivalence: zero and two independently seeded product inputs, fidelity >= 0.9999999999, outside timing
normalization.failure_policy: retain source hash and unsupported reason; never add measurements or omit operations

calibration.allocation: deterministic synthetic words independent of panel instances/runtime; source-hash disjointness checked before execution
calibration.preparation: RX(pi/2) q0; CX q0,q(n-1); then RX(0.23+0.01*q) on every qubit; omitted for zero-state sampling
calibration.cx_word: identical wrapper, with CX a,b between RX and RZ
calibration.coefficient_formula: slope1q/(2*2^n); (slopeCX-slopeWrapper)/2^n; endpoint slopes within each session; median over sessions
calibration.sampling_formula: unweighted affine OLS on zero-state sampling medians; intercept is empirical, not physical launch overhead
calibration.interpolation: PCHIP in n; all common-panel widths are knots; no extrapolation or bridging invalid knots
calibration.fit_scope: synthetic calibration only, shared independently of all outer test labels; optional residual calibration would be a separate outer-train-only method
calibration.model_limit: one pooled RX/RZ coefficient may not capture gate-specific or entanglement-dependent costs; b(n)+m(n)*shots is calibrated on full-register zero-state sampling, not on measured-subset size, classical-result width or output support. Applying this fixed predictor to terminal partial/extra-classical-bit circuits is an explicit adaptation limitation, not an eligibility failure. No inferred m/n scaling, no accuracy-based exclusion and no panel-label-based coefficient fitting.

measurement.process_policy: fresh spawned process for every call, consume queue before join, one monotonic deadline
measurement.label_reduction: median repetitions per session, then median sessions per exact source hash
measurement.resume: completed identity-pinned cells only; interrupted/error/timeout attempts remain recorded and are never replaced

measurement_artifact_contract.scratch: Keep pilot, partial attempts and preflight files under work/ until final validation; do not write them into the public artifact root.
measurement_artifact_contract.pilot_attempts: pilot/attempts.jsonl; 10 selected calibration cells x two arms x 3 sessions x 5 fresh-process repetitions = 300 terminal attempt rows
measurement_artifact_contract.full_attempts: full/attempts.jsonl; all 112 calibration cells and 150 exact-QASM panel hashes, 3 sessions x 5 fresh-process repetitions each. The 10 primary-arm pilot calibration cells may be referenced/reused only when the cell, seed, runner and environment fingerprints match exactly; diagnostic unset-arm attempts are not used as primary labels.
measurement_artifact_contract.no_retry_policy: A terminal failure is retained and remains unavailable; do not retry or replace it. Resume only never-started identities from the same pinned plan/environment.
measurement_artifact_contract.panel_targets_csv: Exactly one row per exact source QASM hash: source_qasm_sha256, outer_fold, runtime_seconds, target_status, original measurement_map (ordered source qbit/cbit index pairs), measurement_map_sha256, measured_qubit_count, measured_classical_bit_count, measured_classical_extent, declared_classical_width, terminal/injective flags, normalized_qasm_sha256, normalized_width, normalized_1q_gate_count, normalized_cx_gate_count. The normalized-QASM hash/counts describe exactly the deterministic RX/RZ/CX QASM passed to the engine, not raw source-DAG counts; leave those fields blank only if normalization is unsupported. Require all attempt rows for a panel hash to agree. Use target_status=runtime_observed and the median of all 15 finite engine-reported samples only when all 15 succeeded; otherwise leave runtime_seconds blank and use unavailable_<terminal_status> or unavailable. Alias rows never multiply the hash-level weight.
measurement_artifact_contract.calibration_model_json: schema_id=maestro-cpu-component-calibration-v1; artifact_status=PASS|FAIL describes structural/hash/provenance validation only; status=complete|complete_with_unavailable_knots preserves scientific calibration availability. Include shot_count=1000, exact coefficient_formula, input_attempt_sha256 containing the attempts-ledger SHA256, attempts_sha256, panel_targets_sha256, calibration_source_qasm_sha256 containing all 112 exact synthetic cell-QASM hashes, and width_coefficients for every width 2..9 with status=valid (C1q,Ccx,b,m finite nonnegative) or unavailable (reason). Retain detailed knots, per-session increments, held-out R512 checks, sampling-fit diagnostics and interpolation validity.

pilot.cells: nine operation cells at n=9 plus zero-state n=9 shots=1000
pilot.order: freeze randomized paired-arm order before calls; seed = first four SHA256 bytes big-endian of root_seed|execution_order_stream|protocol_id|pilot|0 from seed_registry.json
pilot.primary_acceptance: all ten primary cells complete, finite, context-correct and pass original MAD/range stability thresholds
pilot.sampling_pilot_scope: The pilot includes only the n=9 zero-state sampling cell at 1000 shots. It checks within-cell repetition/session stability only; it does not fit or validate the five-knot sampling model. The b,m fit and all five sampling-knot residual checks run only after the full 40-cell sampling calibration is complete.
pilot.projected_duration: Report projected wall time from observed pilot throughput with assumptions and uncertainty; informational only, not a pass/fail gate. Do not invent a cutoff.
pilot.default_arm_role: context-sensitivity diagnostic; its success/failure does not choose primary policy or determine predictor accuracy

stability_rules.cell: Within each session, median absolute deviation of five repetitions <= max(50e-6,0.2*session_median); range of three session medians <= max(50e-6,0.2*median_of_session_medians). Apply to every calibration cell.
stability_rules.heldout: For each operation word and session, predicted_T512=T256+(T1024-T256)/3; require abs(T512-predicted_T512)<=max(50e-6,0.2*T512).
stability_rules.identified_increment: For 1Q use each session's T1024-T256; for CX use each session's (T1024-T256)_CX-(T1024-T256)_wrapper. All three increments must be finite and positive; their median must exceed 50e-6 and their range must be <=max(50e-6,0.2*median_increment).
stability_rules.sampling: Fit unweighted OLS on the five shot-level session-median reductions; b and m finite and nonnegative. At every shot knot require abs(observed-(b+m*shots))<=max(50e-6,0.2*observed); invalid knot remains unavailable.

pilot.linearity_and_identification: R512 is validation only; nonpositive, unresolved, nonlinear or unstable coefficients stay unavailable
pilot.reuse_primary_pilot_rows: allowed only for identical primary calibration cell/session/repetition descriptors and worker context

comparison.median_baseline: Median of finite outer-training hash runtimes, in seconds, not median of test labels.
comparison.ridge: log1p six inputs then inner-training StandardScaler; Ridge alpha in [0.01,0.1,1,10,100] selected by four-way exact-hash GroupKFold on outer-train using mean held-out seconds MAE; ties choose smallest alpha. Refit transformations/model on full outer-train; target log1p, output max(0,expm1).
comparison.graph: Reuse S85 source-DAG encoding and three TransformerConv(64) architecture, six globals ->64->64, head128->512->512->128->1; train-only gate vocabulary and log1p/standardized global inputs. Fresh FP32 Adam lr=5e-4 weight_decay=1e-4, batch32, epochs500, seeds42/1234/31415; no HPO/early stopping; median of seed seconds predictions. Do not invoke its old MPS-label runner unchanged.
comparison.paired_bootstrap: 10000 exact-hash replicates, seed_registry.bootstrap stream; observed delta separate from bootstrap mean

execution.now: worker/evaluator implementation and static checks complete; no measurement/training performed
